verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit doesn't offer explicit cloud region/residency selection, but Enterprise customers can run self-hosted CodeRabbit entirely inside their own infrastructure, which functionally lets them control where data is stored, and self-hosted deployments can fully opt out of data retention. Missing for 10: explicit multi-region cloud hosting options (e.g., EU vs US data centers) for non-self-hosted customers, and any independent confirmation that self-hosted deployment satisfies formal residency/compliance requirements.
